name: Example JSON diff
purpose: Produce a structural diff between two JSON documents for approval cards.
request: Let LucyOS show what actually changed between two config snapshots instead of dumping both.

candidates.why: single-purpose, no runtime dependencies, permissive license

source.provenance_notes: Owner, canonical URL and tag confirmed; tag matches the published release artifact.

license.source_of_truth: LICENSE file read at tag v1.4.2
license.notes: Single license across the tree; no vendored subdirectories with other terms.

evidence.note: Verified directly rather than trusting the README.

evidence.note: Anecdotal; treated as supporting, not decisive.

evidence.claim: Static screen produced no high or critical findings.
evidence.note: A clean screen is not proof of safety.

learned: Structural JSON diffing is small enough to wrap rather than rebuild; the useful pattern is emitting a path-addressed change list rather than a text diff.

wrapped: the diff function, behind aion_core-owned interface
rejected: the library's optional colour-output module (pulls a terminal dependency)

dependencies.lockfile: vendored at a recorded commit with a checksum

permissions: read: the two documents passed in
data_flows: in-process only; nothing leaves the host

findings.title: Recursion depth is unbounded on hostile input
findings.evidence: diff() recurses per nesting level; a deeply nested document can exhaust the stack

security.screening_method: static_screen.py plus manual review of the diff and parser paths; no execution

suites.name: adapter unit tests
suites.notes: happy path, empty documents, type changes, nesting-depth ceiling

suites.name: adversarial input
suites.notes: deep nesting is rejected before recursion rather than crashing

confidence_reasons.evidence: Dependency and license claims verified directly; the stability claim is the maintainer's and unverified.
confidence_reasons.functional_fit: Covers the needed diff shape exactly; colour output not needed.
confidence_reasons.lucyos_compatibility: Pure standard library, no threads, no I/O; fits the stdlib-only policy.
confidence_reasons.security: Small reviewed surface, no network, no filesystem, no secrets; one low finding mitigated by a depth ceiling.
confidence_reasons.license: MIT read directly at the evaluated tag; single license across the tree.
confidence_reasons.test: Happy path and adversarial paths covered; regression suite passes.
confidence_reasons.maintainability: Low volume of change upstream, but a single maintainer is a real bus-factor risk.
confidence_reasons.overall: Small, reversible, well-scoped; held below 95 by the bus factor and the unverified stability claim.

limitations: Nesting deeper than the configured ceiling is rejected rather than diffed.
Diff output is structural, not semantic: reordered list items read as changes.
residual_risks: Single-maintainer upstream could go unmaintained; mitigated because the vendored surface is small enough to own.
Output format could change upstream; pinned version prevents surprise, at the cost of manual updates.

rollback.tested_evidence: Revert rehearsed on the feature branch; suite passed before and after; flag-off path covered by a test.
